    The basic algebra as a full corner #

    Lemma 2.1 (graded-category.tex) works with "the basic algebra B₀ = eAe of A, where e = e_1 + ⋯ + e_n is a sum of primitive orthogonal idempotents, one from each isomorphism class of indecomposable projectives". Here: take a complete set f_s of primitive orthogonal idempotents, one representative f_r in each class of f_s A ≅ f_t A, and e = Σ f_r. Then AeA = A (full_basicCorner) and eAe is basic (isBasicAlgebra_basicCorner).
